Method of Attack: Utilizes game client vulnerabilities and remote command execution (RCE) vulnerabilities in Counter-Strike 1.6 clients to install Trojan by connecting to malicious game servers
Creates malicious servers that infect players with the Belonard Trojan
Installs Trojan as a Windows service named 'Windows DHCP Service' loading WinDHCP.dll
Replaces files in the game client to promote attacker's site and fake game servers
Redirects players attempting to join fake servers to malicious servers exploiting RCE to infect victims
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running the game client
Attack Vector: Connecting to malicious Counter-Strike 1.6 game servers exploiting RCE vulnerabilities
Pre-infected clients used to spread Trojan
Indicators of Compromise: Nickname in game changed to website address hosting infected game client
Game menu showing link to VKontakte CS 1.6 community
Domains used by Trojan for redirecting players to fake servers (some shut down in coordination with REG.ru)
